scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @agentshield/api & npm run dev -w @agentshield/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentshield/shared && npm run build -w @agentshield/api && npm run build -w @agentshield/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agentshield/shared && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
